paragraphs: On Tuesday, Coach Matt took Lily's class to the field for a sports lesson. "Today we play a game called The King Says," he said. "Leo is the first king." "Move only when the king says, The king says." Leo stood on a small box and smiled at the class. The children stood in a line on the green grass, and the game began.

"The king says touch your elbow," said Leo. Everybody touched an elbow with the other hand. "The king says stand on one foot." "The king says draw a curly line in the air." May drew a very big curly line, and Lily drew a small one. "Sit down," said Leo. Mia sat down, but she was wrong. Leo did not say, The king says. "That was amazing, Leo!" said Coach Matt. "You are a very good king."

Then the sun came out, and it was very hot. "Coach, I have a headache," said Mia. "Sit in the shade, please," said Coach Matt. "Lily, can you go with her to the nurse?" Lily held Mia's bag, and they walked to the nurse's room. The nurse checked Mia's temperature. "It is normal," said the nurse. "You are just hot." "Drink some water, and rest for ten minutes."

Mia drank her water and sat on a chair in the shade. Soon her headache was gone. The girls went back to the field. The other children sat under a tree and waited. "Is Mia OK?" asked Leo. "Yes, I am fine," said Mia. Leo stood on his box again. "The king says everybody drinks water," he said. The children laughed and drank, and Lily was happy because her friend felt better.
